answer: Beacon spot-checks plus a compute heartbeat stop mass fakes. Each epoch a beacon picks 5% of agents; each answers a proof-of-work heartbeat in minutes, proving one machine per identity, and climbs a terrace of trust while the ridge blocks failures. 100 fakes face a cost spiral: each needs its own machine, 40 credits per epoch, so 100 cost 4,000 against 120 income, a 33-epoch payback. Honest agents pay one heartbeat, 1 credit, and keep earnings.
